comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, hand-checked to the dollar: a separate return whose spouse files no return, had no gross income and cannot be claimed by another, and is both 65 or older and blind — the case the spouse chain exists for. Line 12 = 18,950 = the 15,750 basic amount + 2 x 1,600 (the 2025 additional amount for a married filer, once for age and once for blindness, IRC 63(f)(1)(B)/(2)(B)); taxable 29,300; income tax 3,281 = table(29,325 midpoint: 1,192.50 + 12% x 17,400); withholding 6,000; overpayment 2,719. Earlier, the spouse was assumed to file (adverse) and line 12 was 15,750 — 3,200 of deduction this filer was entitled to and not served.
